sentences.en: Allstate Insurance, a household name thanks in part to its 50-year-old slogan "You're in Good Hands with Allstate®," is one the largest insurance providers in the country.

sentences.en: By the end of the decade, Allstate began covering towing and emergency service and revolutionized the industry by customizing rates according to a person's driving history.
